class.name: CSGFaceSemanticModifier
class.brief_description: Assigns semantic names to CSG faces by their origin.
class.description: Assigns different semantic names to original, Boolean-generated, bevel-generated, and topology-generated faces. This supports mappings such as STONE_WALL to original faces, STONE_EDGE to bevel faces, and BROKEN_STONE to newly exposed Boolean faces.

members.member: Semantic assigned to newly exposed subtraction faces.
Preserves semantics assigned by an earlier modifier.
